gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 identifies the same false projection identity, explains that invertibility preserves rank rather than the required row space, supplies a concrete counterexample, and traces the failure to the claimed real-spectrum theorem for U_rw. Its repair also recognizes that the theorem requires a valid alternative spectral proof or restriction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries concern the invalid identity F^T D^{-1}=F^T D^{-1}P_F, incorrectly justified by row-space preservation under right multiplication by an invertible diagonal matrix. This invalidates the symmetry/similarity argument and leaves the unconditional real-spectrum and real top-k claims for U_rw false or unsupported.

component_coverage.gold_component: The projection identity and its row-space justification are false; the admissible counterexample demonstrates the failure, so the resulting unconditional real-spectrum theorem for U_rw and its always-real top-k consequence do not hold generally.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 independently diagnoses the exact failed identity and operation, gives a concrete numerical counterexample, identifies the collapse of the symmetry/similarity proof and the loss of real-spectrum support, and proposes the same substantive repair: a valid spectral proof or restriction of the RW variant.
